newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian govt agrees 2.9 % '97 deficit target - radio.
newsitem.headline: Belgian govt agrees 2.9 % '97 deficit target - radio.

text.p: The Belgian government has agreed to cut the state deficit to 2.9 percent of GDP in 1997 from 3.0 percent in 1996, Belgian radio said on Friday.
BRTN radio also said that the total austerity package in the 1997 budget was worth 82 billion Belgian francs.
The government spokeswoman was not immediately available for comment.
The 1997 budget will be presented to parliament on Tuesday.
